title: Permutation in String

monster.name: Anagram Hound
monster.title: Sniffer of Substring Scrambles
monster.defeatQuote: The fixed sliding window frequency match was unmistakable!

description: Given two strings `s1` and `s2`, return `True` if `s2` contains a permutation of `s1`, or `False` otherwise.
constraints: s1 and s2 consist of lowercase English letters
starterCode:
def checkInclusion(s1: str, s2: str) -> bool:
    pass
solutionCode:
def checkInclusion(s1: str, s2: str) -> bool:
    from collections import Counter
    n1, n2 = len(s1), len(s2)
    if n1 > n2: return False
    c1 = Counter(s1)
    c2 = Counter(s2[:n1])
    if c1 == c2: return True
    for i in range(n1, n2):
        c2[s2[i]] += 1
        old = s2[i - n1]
        c2[old] -= 1
        if c2[old] == 0: del c2[old]
        if c1 == c2: return True
    return False
hints: Use a fixed-size sliding window of length len(s1) and compare frequency counts.
